title: Finite etale covers lift over a complete Noetherian base: proper case
statement: Let $A$ be a Noetherian ring and $I\subseteq A$ an ideal such that $A$ is $I$-adically complete [def-weil-pbc-adically-complete-ring]. Put $S=\operatorname{Spec}A$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum] and $S_n=\operatorname{Spec}(A/I^{n+1})$ for $n\ge0$. Let $f:Y\to S$ be a proper morphism [def-weil-proper-morphism] and $Y_n=Y\times_SS_n$ [def-pc-base-change], so that $Y_0=Y\times_S\operatorname{Spec}(A/I)$. Then for every finite etale $Y_0$-scheme $V\to Y_0$ [def-weil-pbc-finite-etale-category] there exist a finite etale $Y$-scheme $U\to Y$ and an isomorphism of $Y_0$-schemes $U\times_YY_0\cong V$. (No henselian hypothesis is assumed: an $I$-adically complete pair is henselian anyway (Stacks, More on Algebra, Lemma 0ALJ), so this is the complete Noetherian case of the essential surjectivity of $\mathsf{FEt}(Y)\to\mathsf{FEt}(Y_0)$ over a henselian pair, but the proof does not use it.)

source.place: Fundamental Groups, Lemma 0GS2, essential-surjectivity proof, complete Noetherian case

proof.text: Apply the compatible infinitesimal-system theorem to the given finite etale V. This produces Yn, fnY, gn, finiteness and etaleness at every level, cartesian transition squares, and the initial over-category isomorphism.

The projection Y_0 to Spec(A/I) is proper by base change. Since fnY 0 is finite, the composite fnY 0 with this projection is proper. A proper f is separated and finite type, so apply algebraize_finite_over_proper to the system. It gives a finite g:U to Y with g followed by f proper, and compatible isomorphisms from its restrictions to Yn.

Etaleness of each fnY n transfers to the restriction of g, since e n is an isomorphism and e n followed by fnY n is the pullback projection. Spec A is locally Noetherian, and so is Y by local finite type of f. The finite g is finite type. Apply etale_of_infinitesimal_restrictions_of_proper using the proper composite supplied by algebraization, giving Etale g.

Bundle g as a finite etale object over Y. The algebraization isomorphism at n=0 is an over-category isomorphism by its projection equation. Transport this isomorphism along I^1=I using equality induction, and compose with the initial isomorphism from Yn 0 to V. This is exactly the requested closed fibre isomorphism.
